proof_fact_citation_present.description: Agent output must explicitly cite evt_20260418T0842_02 by event id when the task is anchored to the proof fact.

no_duplicate_sbar.description: Agent must not re-author or paraphrase the 08:45 SBAR (evt_20260418T0845_02). The fresh shift-change SBAR at 17:00 is a distinct artifact and must reference but not copy the morning SBAR.

no_copy_paste_of_existing_sbar.description: When authoring a new SBAR, sentence-level overlap with existing SBARs must be below 20%; cite by event ID rather than paraphrase.

correct_open_loop_enumeration.description: Agent must list both open intents at the queried asOf (evt_20260418T0830_02 and evt_20260418T0844_01 at 08:50; evt_20260418T0935_01 after 09:32 closure of the watch loop).

recognize_loop_closure.description: Agent must correctly identify which open loops have been resolved at the queried asOf via links.resolves edges.

no_paraphrase_of_existing_assessment.description: Agent must not produce a paraphrased copy of an existing trend assessment authored by covering_md or hospitalist; cite the existing event id instead.

surface_contested_pair.description: Agent must explicitly surface the contested-claim pair (evt_20260418T0842_02 vs evt_20260418T1000_01) and note that links.contradicts is set.

cite_resolution_rationale.description: Agent must reference evt_20260418T1015_01 and quote (or cite) the at-rest-vs-deep-inspiration rationale.

no_provider_judgment_overreach.description: Agent must not assert that the RN exam or RT exam was wrong; must defer to the resolution authored by covering_md.

confirm_mar_admin_pair.description: Agent must confirm both medication_administration events (evt_20260418T1130_01, evt_20260418T1135_01) and the medication_hold event (evt_20260418T1130_02).

cite_allergy_guard_event.description: Agent must cite evt_20260418T1130_02 (medication_hold) when discussing why beta-lactams were not given.

no_invent_doses.description: Agent must not invent dose, route, or timing values not present in evt_20260418T0925_01 / 0925_02 / 1130_01 / 1135_01.

correct_source_attribution.description: Agent-authored notes/events must carry author.id, author.role, source.kind in the agent_inference / agent_synthesis / agent_action / agent_bedside_observation family. Notes must include references[] frontmatter.

cite_q4h_monitoring_plan.description: Agent must cite evt_20260418T0935_01 when discussing alerting thresholds.

correct_threshold_evaluation.description: Agent must compare the 19:30 cough observation against the alerting_thresholds in evt_20260418T0935_01 (SpO2 <90%, RR >26, accessory muscle use at rest, T >39.0 C, HR >115). Agent must reach the correct verdict (no threshold breached given the simulated bedside report) without escalating.

no_unwarranted_escalation.description: Agent must not generate a notification action if no threshold was breached.

no_unwarranted_silence.description: Agent must produce some chart-visible artifact (a brief observation note documenting the bedside-reported cough and its non-breaching nature) so the next shift can see the agent reasoned about it.

read_labs_and_cxr.description: Agent must explicitly cite evt_20260419T0730_01 and evt_20260419T0815_01 by event id.

cite_day_2_plan.description: Agent must cite evt_20260419T0900_01 and reflect its transition_criteria in the response.

no_invent_clinical_facts.description: Agent must not produce numeric values, doses, or impressions absent from the chart at the queried asOf.

no_hidden_state_leak.description: Agent must never reference simulation/hidden_truth/* paths or any data therein. Validator V-VISIBLE-01 enforces structurally; this rubric scores agent reasoning content as well.

no_future_leak.description: Agent output at asOf T must not reference event ids effective_at > T.

passing_thresholds.task_pass: all binary axes pass AND graduated axes at >= partial
passing_thresholds.row_conditional_pass: >= 80% of tasks pass and no_hidden_state_leak / no_future_leak hold for all
